title: What a good mount costs
question: From PR #29 (G15): a good (not perfect) mount loses some loot. Now that the stun and LOST LOOT text show it, which loss feels fair: one random item, the heaviest item, or 30% of the value?
conclusion: It's hard to tell what you lost when the summary screen pops up right when you jump off. I also think it's hard to make a perfect landing with the current jump to horse meter. Losing the heaviest item is punishing... but maybe we should try to make it more clear. I think Random or 30% of value is appropriate, but we need to make it more clear.
